about: Examples that go with rules.json, read by the server's tests (rs/src/scan.rs `table`, rs/src/moderation.rs `flow`). `scan`: a text and the verdict (and category, when given) the scan must give it. `names`: a handle or display name and whether it may be taken. `flows`: the texts and categories the moderation tests post and answer with, by test; rs/src/moderation.rs says what each must be.
